title: Nala Wa Ndzilo
intro: Emasikwini yo sungula ya nhlavutelo, munhu un’wana u humelerile tanihi mukaneti la nonon’hwaka wa ntiyiso. Hi ku katekisiwa hi rifuwo ni xiyimo, moya-xiviri lowu wu hlawule ku tikukumuxa ku tlula nkongomiso, naswona xitori xa vona xi ve xilemukiso lexikulu eka tindzimana to hetelela ta surah.
clues: A ndzi tshama edorobeni rin’we na Muprofeta, naswona a ndzi ri exikarhi ka maxaka ya le kusuhi swinene na yena, hambiswiritano ku tikukumuxa ka mina a ku ndzi hlayisa ndzi ri ekule ni ntiyiso.
A ndzi ri ni rifuwo lerikulu ni nhundzu yo tala, naswona a ndzi ehleketa leswaku rifuwo ra mina ri ta ndzi sirhelela minkarhi hinkwayo.
Loko rungula leri ri paluxiwile, ndzi ri hlekula erivaleni kutani ndzi fularhela, ndzi titeka ndzi tlakukile eka vapfumeri.
Vulala bya mina a byi dume ngopfu lerova surah ya Quran yi ndzi vitane hi ku kongoma, yi ndzi vitana hi vito leri van’wana va ndzi tivaka ha rona.
Ndzi tsundzuxiwile leswaku rifuwo ra mina ni miholo ya mina a swi nge ndzi pfuni nchumu, naswona ndzi ta hoxiwa endzilweni lowu pfurhaka.
Ndzi tiviwa tanihi tata wa langavi, naswona nsati wa mina u ta rhwala tihunyi hi ntambhu ya ntambhu ya ncindzu enhan’wini yakwe.

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Al-Walid ibn al-Mughira, ku vula ka yena

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: U arile Vuislem naswona u kanete Muprofeta erivaleni
U rhangele ku boycott ka ntshamisano eka Mamoslem
trial.answer: U arile Vuislem naswona u kanete Muprofeta erivaleni

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Yi ta hisa hi ndzilo lowu pfurhaka
U hundzukile kutani a va munghana
U lahlekeriwe hi rifuwo rakwe kambe u file a xiximiwile
outcome.answer: Yi ta hisa hi ndzilo lowu pfurhaka

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verse: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained. (111:2)
